display_name: DURA 内部物理和先验联合优化源 IQ GPU 训练
description: 固定原 DURA 作为源 IQ 参考，另加载同源副本，联合更新物理估计和先验；不读取 F、TX 标签或目标。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA v1.0 stage2 E20/4940 source-only checkpoint; trainable independent copy and separate frozen original reference
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura validates original7/63/30 and original DURA F/TX/target access fields; candidate and anchor are separate copies
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source-only original DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Reset AdamW, fixed final 5 incremental epochs after parent E20; no source or target score selection

rows.method: Train independent original-DURA physics and prior weights with source IQ loss, small residual regularization and original-DURA-relative degradation guard
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: Original DURA seed 2026092701, source fit sampling 2026110611, optimizer order 2026110613; no new random model initialization.

notes: Original DURA remains frozen as source reference; a separately loaded candidate copy is trainable. DURA_frozen metadata refers to the source reference, while candidate_dura_trainable is true.
All G training uses only legal L_s/U_s paired IQ and source-only original DURA; no F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target access.
Reset AdamW lr=1e-5, weight decay 0, five fixed incremental epochs, preserving model eval behavior.
Seven Phase1 views and truth-last score proceed irrespective of source metrics; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL used only after candidate freeze.
